page.overview:
What is Uva Academy?

The emblem of Naranja Academy and is a shield baring an orange, and the emblem of Uva Academy is a shield baring a bunch of grapes.

The Entrance Hall connects to the outdoors of Naranja/Uva Academy and the rest of Mesagoza. The player can attend or revisit a class by checking in at the front desk in front of the entrance door. The rest of the hall contains numerous books that the player character can read.

The Cafeteria provides different types of food that the player can buy to obtain Meal Powers. It is also where the player meets Cassiopeia for the first time.

Five-Alarm Sandwich; A veggie-heavy stuffing and a piquant sauce make this sandwich a very refreshing meal.; Egg Power Lv. 1; Teensy Power: Steel Lv. 1; Raid Power: Psychic Lv. 1; 1,700 Peanut Butter Sandwich; The thick sweetness lingers in the mouth—a treat for the taste buds.; Exp. Point Power: Fairy Lv. 1; Encounter Power: Electric Lv. 1; Teensy Power: Ground Lv. 1; 1,020 Potato Salad Sandwich; The potato salad makes this sandwich nicely filling. This is a perfect lunchtime meal.; Item Drop Power: Grass Lv. 1; Catching Power: Rock Lv. 1; Teensy Power: Ghost Lv. 1; 1,200 Pickle Sandwich; Pickles are the only filling in this single-minded sandwich. It's an exceedingly simple meal.; Catching Power: Dark Lv. 1; Encounter Power: Rock Lv. 1; Humungo Power: Dragon Lv. 1; 950 Egg Sandwich; The key is that the eggs aren't scrambled—rather, they are thinly-sliced boiled eggs.; Humungo Power: Fighting Lv. 1; Egg Power Lv. 1; Item Drop Power: Poison Lv. 1; 980
